description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The collection records Android-based LTE, 5G NR and throughput measurements for two UAV sweeps near a private AERPAW base station. The described rectangular trajectory yields radio quality indicators, iperf throughput and geographic positions. Observations are logged at one-second intervals in CSV files. The experiment supports evaluation of wireless coverage and throughput along a defined flight path, without establishing performance beyond the measured campaign. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Aerial cellular throughput and capacity planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
